comments.text: Poor America. This video is the hubris of a political elite out of control. If there is one relentless law about the fall of nations it is that flying too close to the sun always causes a deadly crash to earth. I'm an Australian, 81, with no dog in anyone's fight. But when I look at USA, I see that has engaged in 36 or more major wars and military conflicts and well over 100 foreign military interventions since declaring independence in 1775 [thank you, Google Gemini]. I can't help noticing that in recent times it has lost war after war (with another loss in Iran coming up). There's a reason for that. The video confuses the huge business of buying and selling weapons with security. More particularly, when I look at America I see some of the scaredest people on earth. They are afraid of each other. People in most other countries don't walk around with personal guns in their own towns and cities. Land of the free? USA locks up more of its own citizens than any other country on earth. But it's worse than that. In this supposedly rich country, vast numbers of people are afraid of becoming sick because the health system sucks. They are afraid of losing their jobs because the labour laws suck. The list goes on ... America, stop the bullshit and heal yourself. That's how to get real respect.
